# Anand's Cybersecurity Blog

Personal cybersecurity blog built with [Hexo](https://hexo.io/) and the [Reimu theme](https://github.com/immin/Reimu), deployed via GitHub Pages.

## 📝 About This Blog

This blog covers ethical hacking, tools, research notes, CTFs, and real-world experiments. Content is sourced from the `/posts/` directory and generated using Hexo into static files served through GitHub Pages CDN.

## 📂 Repository Structure

```
.
├── 404.html              # Custom 404 page
├── _config.yml           # Hexo configuration
├── archives/             # Post archives
├── images/               # Blog images and banners
├── posts/                # Blog posts (Markdown)
├── css/                  # Stylesheets
├── js/                   # JavaScript files
├── sw.js                 # Service worker
└── tags/                 # Tag index
```

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Hexo 8.1.1** - Static site generator
- **Reimu Theme** - Clean, responsive design
- **GitHub Pages** - CDN deployment
- **Node.js** - Build toolchain
